<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ce2b1ef07eaa0f0762770dbec9977b9b79d337ab` — the merge of head `5e2b66314ccd628dd2361d61259a63ce45faed22` into base `9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ce2b1ef07eaa0f0762770dbec9977b9b79d337ab && git checkout ce2b1ef07eaa0f0762770dbec9977b9b79d337ab
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710 5e2b66314ccd628dd2361d61259a63ce45faed22 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710 && git merge --no-ff 5e2b66314ccd628dd2361d61259a63ce45faed22

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b959edb9792fe209baec1efc8528a4dc2e5ab220`
Local-runs: none
Scope: HITS-AND-NON-PROSE-PATHS + CITED-FILES — hits: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts`, `18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts`; implementing: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, the two pin files (`packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`); cited, read-only: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`overlaySlotBinding`, `packageScopedHoldersOf`, `isBundleAddition`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`), `protocol-environment-rows.ts` (`packagelessAddress`, `packagelessContentPackage`), `migrations/overlay-index.ts`, `metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts`, ADR-0150 D3, card #33210 and its four comments.
Security-touching: no

First record on this PR; no earlier `## Contract review` to close.

### ① Derived judgments

- (a) `storedRowHoldersRefusal`: a package-less row beside two or more row holders (pair rows and declined rows excluded first) is refused naming the holders; beside one or none the read is left as it was. **Right**: the card's answer, and the registry's own binding rule for such a row (`overlaySlotBinding`: "binds to no package and is no environment item either").
- (a) `servedRowHolderOf`: on the item face the registry's environment item no longer ends the judgment when the rows hold a package-less row beside two or more bound packages. **Right**; traced, every other combination (no package-less row, one candidate, a pair or declined second candidate, a disabled holder) returns what it returned before.
- (c) `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, chained after `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` on the plain read (non-draft) and in `getMetaItemLayered`: **right for the one shape pinned** (one base, one dependent), **wrong as a rule**: M1, S1.
- (d) the `reason` of `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`: **right**; it now says what `storedRowHoldersRefusal` does (rows' bindings at the member; registry holders used for `pairOfAnother` only). The entry's unchanged `acceptanceCriteria` ("never a row") was false for the three-row shape on `main` and is true at this head.
- No answer moves from refused to served: every new path returns a refusal or re-addresses to a base that holds no row at the member.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right arm: nothing widens, so `yes (narrowing)` (widens and narrows) does not apply. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right (no author-writable key moves). `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec` with the `!` title, the BREAKING banner and the `adr-0087: registered …` marker matches AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 for a non-protocol narrowing. The changeset's second bullet and its `Skills-docs:` sentence ("now true for a row-held base too") repeat M1's overclaim and move with its fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 67, every one `success` or `skipped`; none red. Skipped include `Dogfood Regression Gate (shard/3)` and `Dogfood Verify CLI`: the battery the `!`/narrowing arm owes is not evidenced at this head, and the three ablations are not measured (PR body, hand-off 6912091533). Escalated to the seat; not this review's to run.
- `open_questions`: none. Deviations: the PR calls `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` "area-approved" and the new spec entry "seat-approved", but neither approval is on card #33210 or the PR thread. The seat cites them before ACCEPT.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (report 6912056554): a package-less row beside a disabled holder plus served holders leaves the plain read as it was while `/layers` refuses, "noted, not filed". It is the card's own class (red line 2) and needs a carrier card.
- SQL push-down: no finding. `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` reads the item's active rows by `(type, name)` through the face's shared read; no id materialisation, no in-app join over a pushable query.
- Siblings, read-only. `main` since the merge-base: #34322 (canonical-member guard of `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`) and #34354 (`servedHolderAddressOf` gate) merge clean and compose. Open: #34347 serves the package-less entry beside two holders for `doc` (bucket 1, ruling 6893582352) while this PR refuses for by-package types; both follow the registry's two rules (`readBareDoc`, `overlaySlotBinding`), no conflict. #34324 (bare save): the three-row shape is already refused by the rows' bindings, consistent. #34238 (`action` save): disjoint.
- PR is a draft; author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — `18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts` `acceptanceCriteria` and `surface`, against `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`. The entry promises 404 "for every bundled name a base holds only as stored rows and a dependent extends with a member of its own". The function answers the base only when `bases.length === 1`, where `bases` is every row-holding package with no row at the member read. With a row-held base A (`en-US`) and two dependents D1 (`fr-FR`), D2 (`de-DE`), the read at `fr-FR` finds `bases = [A, D2]`, returns `undefined`, and serves D1's row (200) as on `main`. The registry's `isBundleAddition` judges each package against any one holder in its closure, so it names A the one holder there, and a shipped A answers 404. So: the published criterion is false for the ordinary two-language-pack shape; card (c)'s "one operation, one answer" is not met; and the PR adds an answer that flips with an unrelated install (404 with one dependent, 200 once a second arrives). Required: judge the base as the registry does (the one package every other row-holding package is an addition to), or narrow the entry, the changeset and the `Skills-docs:` line to "exactly one other package" and write the remaining difference and its reason on the card. Either way pin two dependents on distinct members. Derived by reading; not run.

S1 (should-fix) — the canonical-member mirror. `overlayMemberValue` answers `null` for no member, so the arm also re-addresses a read naming no member when the dependent holds the canonical member and the base only another one. That read is reachable without `?member=` and from `/published` (it calls `getMetaItem({ type, name })`). It is not measured, not pinned, and outside the entry's `surface` (spelled `?member=MEMBER`, no `/published`). Pin it beside its shipped CONTROL and add it to the surface, or guard the arm to a named non-canonical member.

N1 (nit) — the new entry's `reason` attributes "a bundle addition holds no name" to ADR-0150 D3; D3's text has no such sentence. The rule is #28802 / child R2 (`packageScopedHoldersOf` docblock), as the file's header comment says.

N2 (nit) — `servedRowHolderOf`'s docblock still says it is asked only "when no package-less row and no environment item is stored"; on the item face that is no longer so.

`18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts`: holds, see ① (d).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2b9293e63abc9db1de8ebe939b3e62725534488f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: HITS-AND-NON-PROSE-PATHS + CITED-FILES — delta over record 6915442261: commits `4acbdfe3` and `e0babb98`, i.e. hits `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts`; implementing `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` (`rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, `servedRowHolderOf` docblock), `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, `.changeset/33210-packageless-row-two-holders.md`; cited, read-only: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`isBundleAddition`), `registry-package-addressing.ts` (`packageScopedHoldersOf`), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.ts` (`overlayMemberValue`), `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, card #33210 and its comments.
Security-touching: no

Delta round over the FAIL record 6915442261 (head `b959edb9792fe209baec1efc8528a4dc2e5ab220`). No announce comment from the lane for this head; the PR thread holds only the claim 6922404649 after that record, and card #33210 has no new ruling. Since that head: two merges of `main` (`1b3c2345`, `2b9293e6`) and the two fix commits. The net diff against the merge-base is the same seven files as before; the first merge resolved an import-line conflict in `protocol-meta-item-face.ts` (both sides kept), nothing else by hand. `18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts`, `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` and the REST pin file are unchanged since the earlier record and its judgments on them stand.

### ① Derived judgments

- `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, the base: each row-holding package is now judged against its own dependency closure, and the base is the one row-holding package that is an addition to none. **Right**: with A (`en-US`), D1 (`fr-FR`), D2 (`de-DE`) the base is A at both members, in either registration order, and a dependent of a dependent stays an addition. Two unrelated row holders still give two bases and leave the read to the two-holder judgment. The pair exclusion is widened from "pair of the base" to "pair of any row-holding package": **right**, it only declines to move.
- `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, the member guard (`typeof overlayMemberValue(...) !== 'string'`): the arm moves only a named non-canonical member. **Right** against `overlayMemberValue` (null for no member, an empty one and the canonical value). The read naming no member, `?member=CANONICAL` and `/published` are back to `main`'s answers.
- No answer moves from refused to served: the delta either returns `undefined` where it re-addressed before (canonical member) or re-addresses to a base holding no row at the member (second dependent).
- The stored-member clash rule: **wrong at one corner**, S2.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` still the right arm: the delta widens nothing. `Metadata-protocol: none` right. `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec`, the `!` title, the BREAKING marker and the `adr-0087: registered …` line are unchanged and match. The changeset's second bullet, its "Not moved" paragraph and its `Skills-docs:` sentence now say what the code does (two dependents 404 at each member; the canonical member and `/published` not moved). The PR body was not updated with them: N3.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 67, 56 `success` and 11 `skipped`; none red. `Test Core` (all 8 shards) is green at this head, which is the evidence that the new pins pass; not re-run here. Skipped still include `Dogfood Regression Gate (shard/3)` and `Dogfood Verify CLI`: the battery the `!`/narrowing arm owes is not evidenced, and the PR body's "NOT MEASURED" list (ablations) still names the old head. Escalated to the seat, as before.
- Card (c) says a difference kept for a reason is written on the card. The canonical-member mirror is now kept different from the shipped base, and the reason (a shipped base holding only another member has no one answer: it moves across a reboot) is in the code comment, the pin and the changeset but not on card #33210. The seat writes it there before ACCEPT. That reboot-dependent answer of the shipped shape is `main`'s and the card's own class (one operation, one answer): it needs a carrier card.
- Carried from 6915442261, still open for the seat: the "area-approved" / "seat-approved" surface extensions are on neither the card nor the PR thread; the report's `out_of_scope_findings` (package-less row beside a disabled holder plus served holders) has no carrier card.
- SQL push-down: no finding; the delta adds no read.
- PR is still a draft.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 of 6915442261 — **closed**. `18.row-held-base-addition-bare-read-at-base.ts` now promises 404 "for … one or more dependents each extend[ing] with a non-canonical member of their own", and `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` answers the base for each of them. Pinned by `M1 two dependents` (row-held base in both registration orders beside the shipped base as CONTROL, plain read, `/layers`, execution read, each `?package=` address, the base's own member, before and after a reboot). Not tautological: at the earlier head the row-held rows found two candidate bases and served 200.

S1 of 6915442261 — **closed** by the guard arm it offered. Surface, criterion, reason and changeset name the named non-canonical member only and say the read naming no member and `/published` do not move; `S1 …` pins every bare door at 200 in both save orders, before and after a reboot. The missing shipped CONTROL is explained in the pin (see ③).

N1 — closed (the `reason` and the header no longer attribute the rule to ADR-0150 D3). N2 — closed (`servedRowHolderOf` docblock).

S2 (should-fix) — `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` `isAdditionTo`, against `packageScopedHoldersOf` / `isBundleAddition`. The function's comment says each package is judged "as `isBundleAddition` judges it", but the registry passes `codeMembersOf` (#33127): a member both packages hold only as stored rows is no clash there, so a dependent D storing the base's `en-US` as well as its own `fr-FR` over a row-held A is still an addition and A the one holder. Here any shared member makes D no addition, two bases result, and the read at `fr-FR` stays D's row (200) while a shipped A answers 404. The entry's criterion ("each extend with a non-canonical member of their own") does not exclude that shape. Either apply the registry's clash rule (no name is shipped on this arm, so no stored-only member clashes), or say in the entry and the docblock that a dependent also storing a member the base stores is not moved, and why. Pin whichever. Present at the earlier head too and not named there. Derived by reading; not run.

N3 (nit) — the PR body's `Skills-docs:` sentence ("now true for a row-held base too"), its (c) rows and its verification section still describe the earlier head; the changeset is the corrected text.

## 席位核对 · PR #34355 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T18:15Z
Head-sha: `5e2b66314ccd628dd2361d61259a63ce45faed22`(merge-base 18194fbb,7 个文件 +546/−24)

**结论:REWORK**。三项都很小:两项在 PR 正文,一项在一个测试文件。按我读到的,代码本身可以接受。

**已核对、无问题**
- `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` 判定 M1 时,每个持有存储行的包按自己的依赖闭包判;S2 下没有共享成员冲突;S1 下只对点名的非规范成员生效。以下几种情况它跳过:名字有包在代码中发布、该成员有环境项、该成员的行被拒或无包、有被禁用的持有者、遇到定制配对。item face 和 `/layers` 都走它,draft 读取不走。
- `servedRowHolderOf` 与 `storedRowHoldersRefusal`:无包行旁边有两个及以上持有者时拒绝;只有一个或没有持有者时,读取保持原样。环境项例外现在只在"无包行且候选不少于 2"之外成立。
- changeset:patch、`!`、Clause-② no(收窄)、Metadata-protocol none。Skills-docs 写 none 站得住,我对照了两处:`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:127`("one a dependent adds under the base's name is served only under its own `?package=`",说的是发布名字的基础包),以及 `metadata-lifecycle.mdx:162`。两条 ADR-0087 条目、正文的 FROM→TO 表都与代码一致。
- 测试:
  - (c) 的拒绝:普通读取与 `/layers` 钉了 `[404, 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND']`,执行读取钉 `executed?.item` 为 null。
  - (a) 的拒绝:runtime helper 在普通读取、`/layers`、`/published` 上都钉了 `[409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT']`,执行面也钉了。
  - CONTROL 覆盖了一个持有者、发布的基础包、基础包自己的成员三种情况。
- 钉在本 head 的读数:
  - 正文写明的:dogfood battery 在 `5e2b66314` 下 475 个文件、4018 通过;93/93 派生门禁;消融 A3–A6。
